business_summary: Malion New Materials Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sale, and technical servicing of masterbatches in China and internationally. It operates in three segments: Polymer Materials Business, Fine Chemicals Business, and New Energy Business. The company offers black, white, color, and functional masterbatches, as well as high concentration preforms. It also provides polymer composite coloring materials; fine chemicals, including sodium cyanide, cyanuric chloride, dyes, pigments and intermediates, and hydrogen; and wet-process diaphragms for lithium, sodium, and semi-solid batteries, as well as white sodium-ion battery positive electrode materials. The company exports its products. Its products are used in food packaging, medical packaging, personal care packaging, plastic pipes, engineering plastics, plastic household products, wires and cables, home appliances, daily-use light industry, car, agriculture, courier bag, injection molding, protective film, and cast film applications. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Shantou, China.
